articles.title: More than 100 sick in European Salmonella outbreak
articles.description: Alfalfa sprouts, and possibly other sprouted seeds, are the primary food vehicle in the multi-country outbreak.

articles.title: Concerns voiced after Listeria found in chicken supplied to hospitals; recall initiated

articles.title: FDA imposes stricter import controls because of pesticides, Salmonella and heavy metals
articles.description: The Food and Drug Administration uses import alerts to enforce U.S. food safety regulations for food from foreign countries. The agency updates and modifies the alerts as needed.

articles.title: USDA issues warning about chicken wraps contaminated with Listeria
articles.description: The USDA’s Food Safety and Inspection Service (FSIS) is issuing a public health alert for ready-to-eat chicken Caesar wraps because tests of the product showed contamination with Listeria monocytogenes.  A recall was not requested because the products are no longer available for purchase.
